PR surface: Source +71, Tests +57. Total +128 across 2 files.

target.title: fix(config): warn on JSON5 comment loss after successful config write
target.body:
#### What Problem This Solves

Close #105683

Fixes silent JSON5 comment loss when `openclaw.json` is written back to disk. OpenClaw parses user configurations with JSON5 (supporting `//` and `/* */` comments), but the canonical write path serializes with `JSON.stringify`, which irreversibly strips all user-authored comments, documentation, and commented-out settings on every automatic config mutation (onboarding, plugin install, model updates).

#### Why This Change Was Made

Previous attempt (#105727) added a regex-based detector with a pre-commit warning. ClawSweeper review identified two defects:

1. **Incomplete JSON5 line continuation handling** — the regex only recognized LF/CR/CRLF as escaped line continuators, missing U+2028 (line separator) and U+2029 (paragraph separator) which JSON5 also permits. A valid string containing `\ //` would trigger a false positive warning.
2. **Warning emitted before write commit** — if any later stage (blocking-reason checks, runtime preflight, atomic replacement) rejected the write, users were told comments would be lost while the original file remained untouched.

This fix:
- Replaces the regex with a **character-by-character lexical scanner** that correctly tracks every JSON5 string escape, including U+2028/U+2029 line continuations
- Moves the warning into `logConfigOverwrite()`, which only fires after `replaceFileAtomic` succeeds (`configCommitted = true`)
- Includes recovery guidance pointing to the pre-write backup saved by `maintainConfigBackups`

#### User Impact

- Users with JSON5 comments in `openclaw.json` now see a post-write warning after any automatic config mutation
- The warning includes instructions to diff against the pre-write backup to recover commented-out settings
- False positives eliminated: URLs, `//` in strings, and all JSON5 line-continued strings are correctly ignored
- Plain JSON configs produce no warning

#### Evidence

- **Type check:** `tsgo` passes with no errors
- **Tests:**
  - `io.parse.test.ts` — 11 tests pass (+9: `hasJSON5Comments` covers line comments, block comments, double-quoted strings, single-quoted strings, plain JSON, empty input, escaped quotes, U+2028/U+2029 continuations, LF/CR/CRLF continuations)
  - `io.audit.test.ts` — all tests pass (no regression)
  - `io.write-config.test.ts` — 103 tests pass (no regression)
- **Change scope:** 2 files, +125 lines
  - `src/config/io.ts` — +68: `hasJSON5Comments()` lexical scanner + warning in `logConfigOverwrite` closure (post-commit)
  - `src/config/io.parse.test.ts` — +57: 9 focused tests
  - No new dependencies, no config/CLI/SDK/docs/changelog surface affected
- **Live proof:** standalone script exercising the lexical scanner:

```
=== JSON5 Comment Detection — Proof ===

[Group 1] Line comments outside strings
  ✓ line-start //
  ✓ inline //
  ✓ trailing //

[Group 2] Block comments outside strings
  ✓ block comment
  ✓ inline block
  ✓ multi-line block

[Group 3] Comment markers inside strings — ignored
  ✓ URL in string
  ✓ // in double-quoted
  ✓ /* */ in double-quoted
  ✓ // in single-quoted
  ✓ /* */ in single-quoted

[Group 4] Escaped quotes inside strings
  ✓ escaped quote in string
  ✓ escaped backslash + real comment

[Group 5] JSON5 line continuations (U+2028 / U+2029)
  ✓ U+2028 line separator continuation
  ✓ U+2029 paragraph separator continuation
  ✓ LF line continuation
  ✓ CR line continuation

[Group 6] Plain JSON — no false positives
  ✓ simple object
  ✓ nested
  ✓ empty object
  ✓ empty string
  ✓ whitespace only

[Group 7] Edge: single / not part of comment
  ✓ path with single / in string
  ✓ single / inside string

[Group 8] Contract: detection is boolean, no side effects
  ✓ idempotent
  ✓ no side effects

=== Results: 26 passed / 0 failed ===
```
